params.name: LoadAsync
params.note: Needs component state and an async load run on the first pk-show, and no mapped parameter exposes that event; it would be a hand-written component. Render the content yourself and set it from a handler.

params.name: OnClick
params.note: The element has no click event; put a click handler on the element you wrap.
